instructions: This is a TypeScript Pi extension for filesystem-backed memory. Prioritize correctness, data-loss prevention, path traversal safety, git/memory persistence safety, user-visible output bounds, and missing verification. Avoid style nits.

rules.rule: Filesystem operations must validate user-controlled paths or folder names, avoid path traversal, and avoid overwriting or deleting data without explicit conflict handling.
Tool outputs shown to users or agents should be bounded and avoid dumping large file contents unless the user explicitly requests it.
Do not swallow errors silently. Return or propagate useful context so the caller knows what failed and how to recover.
